summary: The change preserves the permission trust boundary. Part A keeps authority host-reviewed: a scheduled worker-local miss defers to the host coordinator's reviewed-rule decision and NEVER widens the worker's currentAutonomousAllowedToolRules with configured SDK allowedTools (PERM-2 preserved; decision 0116). The settings-owned yolo denylist is now terminal BEFORE the host consult, so a host allow-once/rule can never override that hard boundary (defensive hardening beyond the reported bug). Ungranted capabilities still deny. No new authority is granted to the worker.
non_blocking_findings: Denylist-terminal short-circuit added at the scheduled branch so the denylist cannot be host-overridden.
residual_risks: Whether the host coordinator itself honors the yolo denylist is a pre-existing property outside this change; the worker now enforces it terminally regardless.
